2: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David. Listen to my prayer, God. Do not hide yourself from my supplication.
3: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan,
4: Because of the voice of the enemy, Because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.
5: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.
6: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.
7: I said, "Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.
8: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness." Selah.
9: "I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm."
10: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
11: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.
12: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies do not depart from her streets.
13: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hid myself from him.
14: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.
15: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God's house with company.
16: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is in their dwelling, in the midst of them.
17: As for me, I will call on God. The Lord will save me.
18: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.
19: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.
20: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear, and answer them. Selah. They never change, who do not fear God.
21: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.
22: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.
23: Cast your burden on the Lord, and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
24: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.
